en.title: How to Get Government Legal Aid in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: Bangladesh has a government legal-aid system for eligible people and cases. The National Legal Aid Services organisation/department provides information, district legal-aid offices, forms and online application routes. Eligibility and services depend on current law and rules.

atAGlance.whoFor: A person cannot afford legal help or wants to know whether government legal aid can assist.
atAGlance.mainRule: Bangladesh has a government legal-aid system for eligible people and cases. The National Legal Aid Services organisation
atAGlance.updateStatus: LAW UPDATED: Legal Aid Services (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 45 of 2026). Re-check current eligibility and forms before publication.

en.lawMeaning:
The legal-aid law was amended in 2026. Use current eligibility, mediation and service rules rather than older brochures.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check the type of help available.
Complete the official form or online application.
Follow instructions from the legal-aid office.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A person with a pending family dispute cannot afford a private lawyer. They should check the current legal-aid eligibility and apply through the official district or online route instead of paying an unknown intermediary.
commonMistakes: Using a fake “legal aid” Facebook page.
assuming every case is automatically eligible..
en.specialistTrigger: Urgent arrest/detention; violence; deadline; complex appeal; eligibility dispute.
en.disclaimer:
This page provides general legal information about Bangladesh. It is not individual legal advice. Laws, procedures, fees and official instructions can change. Check the cited primary sources before taking action.
